chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from 'Ali ibn al-Hakam, from 'Ali ibn Abi Hamzah, from Abi Basir, who said:
I asked him about salat of the eclipse, and he said: ten rak'ahs and four sajdahs.

key_terms.أَرْبَعُ: four; the number mentioned for sajdahs
key_terms.الْكُسُوفِ: the eclipse; referring to the eclipse prayer
key_terms.صَلَاةِ: salat (prayer), the ritual prayer being discussed
key_terms.عَشْرُ: ten; the total number mentioned in the ruling

ai.seo_question: How many rak'ahs and sajdahs are in salat al-kusuf according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states the number of units in salat al-kusuf. It conveys a legal ruling describing the structure of the eclipse prayer as ten rak'ahs and four sajdahs.
